name: notte
description: Drive a real cloud or local browser with Notte — manage sessions and accounts from the CLI, and build, deploy, and repair Notte Functions

interface.shortDescription: Drive a real cloud or local browser and deploy the result as a callable Function
interface.longDescription: Launch and control Notte cloud browser sessions from the CLI: navigate, observe, click, fill, and scrape JavaScript-rendered pages, manage vaults and personas for authenticated flows, then deploy a tested browser task as a Notte Function — an API-callable, schedulable endpoint — and diagnose or repair it when the site changes.
defaultPrompt: Scrape this page with Notte and return structured JSON
Run this browser task on a Notte cloud session behind login
Turn this working scrape into a scheduled Notte Function
